data.description:
# P2 (CRITICAL): Replace sprint-complete auto-disable with review policy on live path; audits keep draining deep review queue

Child of RCA WL-0MTTS9FY00055QJV (root causes A + B2). Parent: WL-0MTTS9FY00055QJV.

## Problem statement

Two coupled defects silently halted ContextHub's overnight dispatch Sep 8→9 (0 dispatches, ~9 h 20 m silence, check-ins ceased 21:53Z→07:11Z) and make the producer-approved review policy ineffective. The sprint-complete auto-disable (WL-0MTHSHN5V008R5L0) stops *all* dispatch and check-ins when root-only `completed/in_review` ≥ `browseItemCount`; the intended review-queue-depth gate (WL-0MT2UQWOR007CYY9) that should hold only non-critical implement work is unreachable on the production Herdr-head path, so non-critical implements still dispatched freely.

## Users

- **Producer / sprint lead** — wants a deep `completed/in_review` queue to drain via audits without new non-critical implementation piling on, and a distinct signal when the queue is deep vs a genuine sprint-complete.
- **Downtime dispatcher (herdr)** — must keep checking in and keep dispatching audits/plan/intake/critical while the queue is deep, holding only non-critical implement and reporting a distinct `review-queue-hold` reason when nothing audit-needed remains.

### User stories

- As a producer, when `completed/in_review` (root-only) ≥ `browseItemCount` I want audits of `in_review` items to keep dispatching so the review queue drains, while new non-critical `plan_complete→implement` work is held, so the review bottleneck is not overloaded.
- As a producer, when the queue is deep and nothing needs audit I want the worker to report `review-queue-hold` (not hide behind the no-candidate cooldown) so polling resumes immediately when the queue thins.
- As an operator, I want coordination check-ins to continue regardless of queue depth so the ContextHub 21:53Z silence (no log lines at all) cannot recur.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. With root-only `completed/in_review` ≥ `browseItemCount`, audit-kind candidates still dispatch (verified on a fixture with a deep queue and an audit-needing item).
2. Non-critical implement-kind items are skipped while the queue is deep; plan/intake/critical implement continue; the skip reports `review-queue-hold` (never `no-candidate`/cooldown) when nothing audit-needed remains.
3. The sprint-complete auto-disable no longer halts coordination check-ins or audit/plan/intake dispatch; `.herdr-downtime-disabled` write/clear semantics are scoped to the policy above (or removed if superseded by the gate).
4. The gate is applied identically in `dispatchFromHerdrList`, `computeMostImportantItem` (offer computation) and `dispatchFromCoordination`; the legacy-only copy (~2497–2541) is removed or made shared.
5. Regression tests cover: threshold crossing both directions, audit-still-flows, non-critical-implement-held, plan/intake/critical-unaffected, `review-queue-hold` reason.
6. Full herdr suite + `npm run build` green; `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` updated.
7. Replay evidence: with ContextHub at ≥20 root-only `in_review` the worker keeps checking in and auditing (the 21:53Z silence does not recur).

## Constraints

- `browseItemCount` default 20, live re-read from settings (no restart); root-only counting via `wl list --status completed --stage in_review --root-only --json`.
- Fail-closed: count-query failure → gate active (hold non-critical implement), exactly as the code-freeze/queue-depth conventions.
- `.herdr-downtime-disabled` marker at the worklog root must not be repurposed to stop audits/plan/intake/check-ins; if a genuine sprint-complete signal is still desired it must be a distinct, explicit mechanism (reconcile WL-0MTHSHN5V008R5L0's purpose).
- No new persistence mechanism; reuse existing marker/fetch helpers where possible.
- Ticks remain cheap: one extra bounded `wl list` per dispatch/offer computation, within `DOWNTIME_WL_TIMEOUT_MS`.

## Existing state

- `createDowntimeWorker.tick()` (downtime-worker.ts ~3110) calls `fetchCompletedItemCount()` (fetcher.ts:684) = `wl list --status completed --stage in_review --root-only`; count ≥ `browseItemCount` writes `.herdr-downtime-disabled` and early-returns before leader-election/check-in → no log lines, no dispatch. Reproduced Sep 8 21:34Z (colour-code/audit batch pushed count to 20) → silence 21:53Z → resume 07:11Z at 19.
- Review-queue-depth gate (WL-0MT2UQWOR007CYY9, `reviewQueueCount ≥ browseItemCount` → skip non-critical implement, audits never gated) lives only in legacy tier chain `dispatchDowntimeWork` ~2497–2541, unreachable when the Herdr head (`fetchNextItems(30)`, index.ts) is non-empty. `dispatchFromHerdrList` (~1394), `computeMostImportantItem` and `dispatchFromCoordination` never call `getReviewQueueCount` (evidence: TCE dispatched 2 non-critical implements overnight with 37 `in_review` incl. children).
- Current production path is Herdr-head ranked (WL-0MTK1ILM2009QYB2); legacy tier chain is dead.

## Desired change

- Scope or remove the sprint-complete auto-disable so it does **not** stop coordination check-ins, audits, plan, intake, or critical implements; if a sprint-complete banner/signal remains it must be independent of the review-queue depth threshold.
- Wire the review-queue-depth gate onto the live path: `dispatchFromHerdrList`, `computeMostImportantItem`, and `dispatchFromCoordination` all apply `reviewQueueCount ≥ browseItemCount` → hold non-critical `implement`-kind only; audits/plan/intake/critical flow unconditionally; neutral `review-queue-hold` when deep and nothing audit-needed.
- Share the gate implementation (single helper / single `getReviewQueueCount` call site) and delete the legacy-only copy or delegate to it.
- Add regression tests, update `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md`, verify build and replay evidence.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Sprint-complete signal scope creep:** producer may still want a visible sprint-complete cue (banner/marker) independent of queue depth — record as a follow-up if requested; this item does not expand to reimplement a sprint-complete feature beyond scoping/removing the queue-depth masquerade.
- **Assumption:** `browseItemCount` (default 20) is the correct threshold for the producer policy; live re-read is cheap and already cached by `loadSettings()`.
- **Assumption:** root-only counts are authoritative for the queue drain (per 2026-08 decision); child `in_review` counts are managed via the parent rollout and are not part of the gate.
- **Risk — tick cost:** an extra bounded `wl list --root-only` per dispatch/offer must stay within `DOWNTIME_WL_TIMEOUT_MS` and not regress check-in cadence (mitigation: bounded timeout, fail-closed to gate-active).
- **Risk — marker file race:** concurrent breech/clear of `.herdr-downtime-disabled` across roots is local per worklog root; no cross-root coordination required (marker is per-root).

## Key Files

- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.ts` — `tick()` sprint-complete auto-disable block (~3110–3135), `dispatchFromHerdrList` (~1394), `computeMostImportantItem`, legacy gate (~2497–2541), `dispatchFromCoordination`
- `packages/herdr/src/fetcher.ts` — `fetchCompletedItemCount` (684), `fetchNextItems` / `getHerdrListHead` contract
- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-disable-marker.ts` — `.herdr-downtime-disabled` semantics (scope/remove)
- `packages/herdr/src/index.ts` — `getReviewQueueCount` / `getHerdrListHead` wiring
- `packages/herdr/src/downtime-worker.test.ts` — regression matrix for the 5 gate cases
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` — review-queue-hold policy, gate placement, sprint-complete reconciliation

## Related work

- Parent RCA: WL-0MTTS9FY00055QJV (Root causes A + B2; P2 is its CRITICAL child)
- WL-0MTHSHN5V008R5L0 — Auto-disable dispatching when sprint is complete (feature to reconcile/scope; marker mechanism reused)
- WL-0MT2UQWOR007CYY9 — Downtime dispatch: gate non-critical implement tier on review-queue depth (gate logic to rewire to production)
- WL-0MTK1ILM2009QYB2 — Dispatcher == Herdr list head contract (determines which dispatch path is live)
- WL-0MTF0KLO10043YAN / WL-0MTII4CWT00452HU — Leader election & machine coordination dir (check-in liveness context)
- WL-0MT50LKAK001EF5Q — Bounded concurrent dispatches (capacity context for overnight evidence)

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **WL-0MSQ6N7GP0088CS5** – Apply in_review close-preservation fix in sync merge (completed)
- **WL-0MSI0DWF50070JMT** – [test-failure] tests/cli/smoke.test.ts — failing test (completed)
- **WL-0MM1CD3SP1CO6NK9** – wl next excludes epics from candidate list, making childless critical epics invisible (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — downtime dispatcher + Herdr list head contract
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md` — deep-dive ref (leader election, Herdr-head contract)
- `CHANGELOG.md`

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q: "Is the review-queue count root-only or all items?" — Answer (producer via WL-0MT2UQWOR007CYY9, decision 2026-08; RCA WL-0MTTS9FY00055QJV Evidence): root-only `wl list --status completed --stage in_review --root-only --json`. Source: work-item descriptions + RCA table (ContextHub root-only 19/20). Research: `fetchCompletedItemCount` already queries `--root-only`.
- Q: "Should audits keep flowing when the queue is deep?" — Answer (producer, RCA Answers Q2 & Desired behaviour): Yes — audits are the queue drain and are never depth-gated; only non-critical implement is held. Source: RCA "Shouldn't we permit audit ...? — Yes" + this item's Desired behaviour section. No interview round needed — policy was approved in the RCA.
- Q: "Does sprint-complete auto-disable equal review-queue-depth gating?" — Answer (RCA Root causes A vs B2): No — distinct mechanisms. A is the live halt (auto-disable on `completed/in_review` ≥ `browseItemCount` with early-return before check-in); B2 is the intended gate (skip non-critical implement) which is dead on production. Reconciliation is an explicit AC (AC3) — review WL-0MTHSHN5V008R5L0 and do not let queue depth masquerade as sprint completion. Source: RCA Sep 8→9 correlation 21:34Z→21:53Z→07:11Z.
- Q: "What reason should a deep-queue hold report when nothing is audit-needed?" — Answer (design notes from WL-0MT2UQWOR007CYY9 + Desired behaviour): distinct `review-queue-hold` (neutral, never `no-candidate`/cooldown). Mirrors code-freeze neutral-reason convention; polling must resume immediately when the queue thins. Source: work-item AC2.

*Interview style:* concise, max three per round. No further producer questions — seed context from RCA WL-0MTTS9FY00055QJV and linked items WL-0MTHSHN5V008R5L0 / WL-0MT2UQWOR007CYY9 was sufficient to draft; interview skipped per intake hard requirements (do not ask answerable-by-repo questions).
